title: Onesia room hardware and CCTV pipeline
note: Concept figure. My part is the REST API on the mini PC and the CCTV pipeline. The devices and the room control apps already existed.

layers.title: Room control apps
layers.description: They call one REST API on the mini PC. These are the existing control website and mobile app. I did not build them, and they reach every device through the API.

layers.title: Attendance device
layers.description: Connected over WebSocket. It takes face scan, fingerprint, RFID card and QR. The same device opens the door for registered employees.

layers.title: Meeting screen
layers.description: Connected over TCP, through its converter. The API controls power, volume, brightness and contrast of the interactive flat panel.

layers.title: CCTV pipeline
layers.description: A camera feeds 8 detectors, which produce events and reports. It detects people and vehicles on live CCTV in real time. A new detector plugs in without touching the rest.
